scanReading.disclaimer: When it is on, every scanned PDF you upload is sent in full to LandingAI, in the United States, to extract its text with your key or your firm's, and that text is saved in LiTT. LandingAI charges your account directly, about USD 0.01 per page at its rates. If your plan has no zero data retention (offered only on the Team and Enterprise plans), LandingAI may keep your documents and use them to improve its products and train its models; with zero data retention, it deletes them when it finishes and does not use them for training. LandingAI is a third party that you choose and contract, so LiTT does not control and is not responsible for how it handles your documents: check its terms before you send it client documents. It is optional: if you leave it off, LiTT does not read scans, and you can upload a PDF that has already been through OCR, using your scanner's searchable-PDF option or a PDF program.
